notes.title: Teslagrad devs reveal Knuckle Jet, a jetpunk nose-breaking ricochet action platformer
notes.content:
From Rain Games who made Teslagrad, Girl Genius: Adventures In Castle Heterodyne and World to the West their next game is Knuckle Jet.

Read the full article here: https://www.gamingonlinux.com/2025/03/teslagrad-devs-reveal-knuckle-jet-a-jetpunk-nose-breaking-ricochet-action-platformer/
